items.heading: High Score
items.text: High score: You know what you will study each day, you plan backwards from dates, and you do not leave hard topics for the last minute.

items.heading: Low Score
items.text: Low score: You often decide what to study only after sitting down, or plans exist in your head and fall apart when the week gets busy.
